ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels occupying approximately 90% of the fluke surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to circular ring contours and the median notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed, upward-sweeping distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and heavy serration along the trailing edge; global presence of circular parasitic/barnacle attachment scars.
